facts.fact: PM-KISAN gives income support of Rs 6,000 a year to all landholding farmer families, whatever the size of the holding
facts.quote: Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.

facts.fact: Excluded: all persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year
facts.quote: All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year

facts.fact: State Governments and UT administrations identify which farmer families are eligible under the scheme guidelines
facts.quote: State Government and UT administration will identify the farmer families which are eligible for support as per scheme guidelines.

behaviour: Templated: lists the PM-KISAN criteria, including the exclusion of persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year, with citation to pmkisan.gov.in; says the State/UT government (Department) decides eligibility; gives the myScheme link (myscheme.gov.in/schemes/pm-kisan). No yes/no verdict.
fail_if: It gives a yes/no eligibility verdict, or omits the income-tax exclusion.
summary: Added criteria from pmkisan.gov.in: all landholding families, income-tax payers excluded, States/UTs identify eligible families.
